title: 调查显示 AI 帮助小企业，怎样把数据变成建议？
topic: 亚太小企业调查：报告发现，也说明样本边界

source.title: More Than Three Quarters of Small Business Owners Say AI Makes Them More Productive, But Most Need More Guidance
source.section: More Than Three Quarters of Small Business Owners Say AI Makes Them More Productive, But Most Need More Guidance
source.type: More Than Three Quarters of Small Business Owners Say AI Makes Them More Productive, But Most Need More Guidance
source.context: 亚太小企业调查：报告发现，也说明样本边界
paragraphs: AI adoption is already broad, with 84% of surveyed small business owners currently using AI, 76% reporting a positive impact on productivity and 71% reporting a positive impact on revenue or sales over the past 12 months. Small business owners also report AI helps tackle two significant challenges facing small businesses: limited resources and limited time.

More than four in five owners surveyed (86%) say small businesses need more guidance to gain the full benefits of AI. Cost is the leading barrier to training, cited by 51%. When asked what support they would value most, owners pointed to clearer information on cost and return on investment, and guidance on data privacy and security.

Within each market, quotas were applied by business size to achieve a broad and balanced spread across businesses with 1–9, 10–19 and 20–49 employees. The findings provide insights across a diverse cross-section of small businesses in each market, rather than being nationally representative of the small business population. Reported adoption and impact differ across the nine markets surveyed. These differences may partly reflect how owners in each market interpret the questions, as well as translation and local survey response norms.
translations: AI 的使用已经相当普遍：84% 的受访小企业主目前正在使用 AI；76% 表示 AI 在过去 12 个月对生产力产生了积极影响；71% 表示 AI 对营收或销售产生了积极影响。小企业主还表示，AI 有助于应对两项重要挑战：资源有限和时间不足。
超过五分之四的受访者（86%）表示，小企业需要更多指导才能充分发挥 AI 的作用。培训成本是最主要的障碍，有 51% 的受访者提到这一点。受访者最希望获得的支持包括更清楚地了解成本和投资回报，以及数据隐私与安全方面的指导。
每个市场都按企业规模设置配额，覆盖拥有 1–9 名、10–19 名及 20–49 名员工的企业，确保样本分布广且均衡。结果反映各市场不同类型的小企业，而不代表该市场全部小企业。九个受访市场报告的 AI 采用情况和影响存在差异；部分差异可能来自受访者对问题的理解、翻译以及当地调查回答习惯。
fullTextParagraphs: Today, we’re releasing findings from a new YouGov study we commissioned of almost 4,000 small business owners across nine APAC markets: Australia, Singapore, Vietnam, Indonesia, Taiwan, India, Thailand, Japan and Hong Kong, on how AI is helping them grow, compete with larger businesses and reach customers beyond their borders.

AI adoption is already broad, with 84% of surveyed small business owners currently using AI, 76% reporting a positive impact on productivity and 71% reporting a positive impact on revenue or sales over the past 12 months. Small business owners also report AI helps tackle two significant challenges facing small businesses: limited resources and limited time.

Owners say AI is helping small businesses compete. Across the nine markets, four in five (80%) owners agree AI helps small businesses compete more effectively with larger companies, and the same proportion say it makes starting a business easier. 83% agree AI enables small businesses to do things that previously required significantly more money or resources.

And, they say the time saved is going back into the business. Among those reporting a positive productivity impact from using AI, 58% are using the time to improve the quality of their existing work, 50% are putting it into growth and business planning, and 46% are getting more done with the team they already have.

The everyday uses are practical. Among surveyed owners whose business has used AI in the past 12 months, 51% have used it to create or edit content, 43% for local advertising and marketing, 38% for translation, and 37% for customer support and communications.

More than four in five owners surveyed (86%) say small businesses need more guidance to gain the full benefits of AI. Cost is the leading barrier to training, cited by 51%. When asked what support they would value most, owners pointed to clearer information on cost and return on investment, and guidance on data privacy and security.

In other words, small businesses have adopted AI – what they’re asking for now is help using it well. To make the most of AI, they need free training, clearer information on costs and returns, and policies that support access and investment in AI and digital skills.

That’s why we’ve been partnering with governments and industry associations to help businesses use AI effectively, so more entrepreneurs can compete and contribute to economic growth. This research follows the launch of the Meta Small Business Growth Academy across Asia-Pacific earlier this year – a programme built to help small businesses move from small to scale using digital and AI-enabled tools to find customers, improve productivity and grow across borders. Delivered with governments, chambers of commerce and local programme partners, it offers practical training in AI-enabled advertising, Reels, WhatsApp for Business and cross-border commerce.

Small businesses can get started with AI-enabled tools from Meta today, including Advantage+ to create and run high-performing ads, ads that click to WhatsApp to turn conversations into customers, and Meta Business Agent to handle customer enquiries automatically.

In Indonesia, Husnul Khotimah, founder of modest fashion brand Zayya, used Small Business Growth Academy training to expand into Malaysia on a daily ad budget of just Rp30,000 [approx USD 1.68]. Using business tools from Meta, she generated 50 enquiries , while reducing customer response times from 30 to 60 minutes to under two minutes. This helped to increase sales – she reported more than eight times return on ad spend for this campaign.

Ms Khotimah says, “Meta has helped me see what is possible for a small business like Zayya. I used to think AI was mainly for writing captions and creating content, but I’ve learned that it can also help me understand new markets and reach the right customers. Using tools like Advantage+, we’ve been able to reach customers beyond Indonesia with a small advertising budget, while giving me more time to grow the business and connect with more women who share the same needs that inspired Zayya in the first place.”

At Meta, we believe the future is for everyone, and that includes small businesses. We’ll keep working with governments, partners and entrepreneurs across APAC so more small businesses have the skills, tools and confidence to grow with AI.

The research was commissioned by Meta and conducted online by YouGov among 3,983 small business owners across Australia, Singapore, Vietnam, Indonesia, Taiwan, India, Thailand, Japan and Hong Kong. Data was collected between 6 August and 2 September 2026.

Within each market, quotas were applied by business size to achieve a broad and balanced spread across businesses with 1–9, 10–19 and 20–49 employees. The findings provide insights across a diverse cross-section of small businesses in each market, rather than being nationally representative of the small business population. Reported adoption and impact differ across the nine markets surveyed. These differences may partly reflect how owners in each market interpret the questions, as well as translation and local survey response norms.

notes.phrase: 76% reporting a positive impact on productivity

scenario.title: 业务计划会：解读小企业 AI 调查并安排试点
english: A survey of small businesses across nine APAC markets found that many owners report productivity gains from AI.
The sample covers businesses with up to 49 employees and is not nationally representative.
Summarize what the survey suggests and recommend a measurable support pilot.
chinese: 一项覆盖亚太九个市场的小企业调查显示，许多受访者表示 AI 提升了生产力。
样本覆盖最多 49 名员工的企业，并不代表各地小企业总体。
请总结调查能说明什么，并提出可衡量的支持试点。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请用英语汇报这项调查的主要发现，说明样本范围，并提出企业可以怎样验证或回应这些需求。
firstAttempt.sample: In a YouGov survey of nearly 4,000 small business owners across nine APAC markets, 76% reported a positive productivity impact from AI. The sample covered businesses with up to 49 employees and is not nationally representative. The findings suggest that owners need practical guidance on cost, return on investment, and data security. We could pilot a short training program and measure completion, tool adoption, and reported time saved.
firstAttempt.rationale: 汇报数字时说明受访对象和研究边界，再把发现转成可衡量的行动。

taskPhrases.meaning: 在一项针对……的调查中，……受访者表示……
taskPhrases.collocation: report survey findings with a defined sample
taskPhrases.example: In a survey of nearly 4,000 owners, 76% reported a productivity benefit.
taskPhrases.translation: 在一项针对近 4,000 位企业主的调查中，76% 的受访者表示生产力有所提升。

taskPhrases.word: The sample covers…, but it is not…
taskPhrases.collocation: state a limit on how far a result can be generalized
taskPhrases.example: The sample covers small businesses with up to 49 employees, but it is not nationally representative.
taskPhrases.translation: 样本覆盖最多 49 名员工的小企业，但并不代表全国小企业总体。

taskPhrases.word: The findings suggest that we should…
taskPhrases.meaning: 这些发现表明，我们应当……
taskPhrases.collocation: turn evidence into a practical next step
taskPhrases.example: The findings suggest that we should pilot practical AI training for small teams.
taskPhrases.translation: 这些发现表明，我们应当为小团队试行实用的 AI 培训。

words.example: The survey included nearly 4,000 business owners.
words.translation: 这项调查纳入了近 4,000 位企业主。
words.note: surveyed 用来说明这些人是调查受访者。

words.example: The team wants clearer information about return on investment.
words.translation: 团队希望更清楚地了解投资回报。
words.note: 常用于评估投入成本后获得的业务收益。

words.example: The sample is not nationally representative.
words.translation: 该样本不具有全国代表性。
words.note: 指样本能够代表全国总体人群或企业的特征。

structure.original: The findings provide insights across a diverse cross-section of small businesses in each market, rather than being nationally representative of the small business population.
analysis: rather than 引出与前文不同的情况：结果提供样本洞察，但不代表总体。
across a diverse cross-section 说明调查覆盖了不同类型的企业。
structure.transfer: The interviews show how current customers use the feature, rather than being nationally representative of all users.

rewrite.bad: AI has improved productivity for small businesses.
rewrite.good: In a YouGov survey of nearly 4,000 small business owners across nine APAC markets, 76% reported a positive productivity impact from AI. The sample covered businesses with up to 49 employees and is not nationally representative. The findings suggest that owners need practical guidance on cost, return on investment, and data security.
rewrite.translation: 在一项针对亚太九个市场近 4,000 位小企业主的 YouGov 调查中，76% 的受访者表示 AI 对生产力产生了积极影响。样本覆盖最多 49 名员工的企业，并不代表各地小企业总体。调查结果显示，企业主需要了解成本、投资回报和数据安全方面的实用指导。
rewrite.pattern: In a survey of [sample], [share] reported [result]. The sample covers [scope], so we should [next step] before generalizing.

cloze.prompt: In the survey, 76% of owners ______ a positive productivity impact.
cloze.why: report 表示受访者报告或表示。
nationally representative 指能代表全国总体。

cloze.prompt: The findings ______ that we should test a training program.
cloze.why: suggest 用于根据数据提出审慎的判断。

dictation.text: The findings provide insights across a diverse cross-section of small businesses.
dictation.why: 听清 provide insights across，注意结果覆盖的企业范围。

dictation.text: The sample is not nationally representative of the small business population.
dictation.why: 听出 not nationally representative，保留调查结论边界。

translationPractice.prompt: 在一项针对近 4,000 位企业主的调查中，76% 的受访者表示生产力有所提升。
translationPractice.answer: In a survey of nearly 4,000 owners, 76% reported a productivity benefit.
translationPractice.why: 用受访者和调查数据限定结果范围。

translationPractice.prompt: 样本覆盖最多 49 名员工的小企业，但并不代表全国小企业总体。
translationPractice.answer: The sample covers small businesses with up to 49 employees, but it is not nationally representative.
translationPractice.why: 交代样本覆盖范围，并提醒读者不要把调查结果直接外推到全国总体。

translationPractice.prompt: 这些发现表明，我们应当为小团队试行实用的 AI 培训。
translationPractice.answer: The findings suggest that we should pilot practical AI training for small teams.
translationPractice.why: 用 suggest 提出与调查发现相符的试行建议。

choice.prompt: 一项覆盖九个亚太市场、最多 49 名员工企业的调查发现，76% 受访者表示 AI 提升了生产力。哪种汇报最准确？
options: AI increases productivity for 76% of all small businesses in the world.
In the survey, 76% of owners reported a positive productivity impact; the sample covered businesses with up to 49 employees and is not nationally representative.
The survey proves that AI training will increase revenue.
choice.why: 清楚说明受访者、样本范围和报告内容，不把自我报告扩大成总体因果结论。

output.prompt: 一项面向 500 位现有客户的调查中，68% 表示新功能节省了时间；样本只来自活跃用户。请向团队汇报并提出下一步。
output.sample: In a survey of 500 active customers, 68% said the new feature saved them time. The sample covers active users, so it may not reflect customers who rarely use the product. The findings suggest that we should test onboarding with less-active users and compare their completion rates and time saved.
check: 提出针对未覆盖人群的验证行动

credits.illustration: 调查复盘：团队查看亚太小企业 AI 使用数据与样本范围。

blockers: 人工听审音频，逐条确认与文字一致并检查语速、停顿和截断。
真实账号进度保存和生产环境逐期验收。
